summary_1line: Arjuna visits cursed sacred waters, fights a crocodile that transforms into an apsara, who recounts being cursed with companions by an ascetic they tried to seduce.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna wrestles a massive crocodile from the sacred pool and drags it onto the shore where it transforms into a radiant jeweled apsara.
Five celestial apsaras descend into a forest clearing to tempt a radiant young ascetic absorbed in meditation beneath towering trees.
